name: Receptive Field Voxel Extraction with Masking
definition: Extracts a local neighborhood (receptive field) of voxels around normalized sample points, masking out-of-bounds accesses and computing the mean of the valid neighborhood.
summary: Receptive Field Voxel Extraction with Masking extracts local voxel neighborhoods and computes their mean, using explicit masking to exclude out-of-bounds data and prevent boundary bias.
